label: NVIDIA MotionBricks

unit.label: time on an NVIDIA GPU the person runs, own or rented; no charge per job

motion.note: From the last four poses (30 Hz) to 1 to 4 target poses: 18 to 58 frames per generation (about 0.6 to 1.9 s), chained for longer motion. SOMA skeleton only: poses go in and clips come out on SOMA, so retargeting carries them between the project rig and SOMA both ways. No text or scene input; flat ground; fingers are not animated.

transports.name: jam-3d-motionbricks
transports.note: Generation runs on a host that meets MotionBricks' requirements (an NVIDIA GPU of compute capability 7.5 or higher with a CUDA 12 driver, Windows or Linux x86-64); the skill's host check says whether a machine does. Packing and unpacking may run on another machine.

pacing.typicalWait: Seconds per request once a TensorRT plan exists; the first run of a precision on a host builds its plan, which takes minutes.

quote.how: No price per job. On a rented GPU its hourly rate applies, billed by its host outside this ledger.

recovery: Nothing is charged, so a lost result is generated again from the same request. Identical inputs on the same backend and precision give the same motion.
notes: Generation needs an NVIDIA GPU under Windows or Linux; there is no macOS build.
The sample motions NVIDIA ships are for evaluation only: never ship them, or target poses or motion taken from them.
